question: International Bank for Reconstruction and Development is commonly known as:
solution:
The correct answer is__** World Bank.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **International Bank for Reconstruction and Development (IBRD)** is one of the five organizations that make up the **World Bank Group**.
 
• It was established in **1944** to help Europe rebuild after World War II and now serves as a global development cooperative.
 
• The IBRD provides **financial and technical assistance to developing countries for development projects.**
 
• The IBRD issues loans to middle-income and credit-worthy low-income countries at favorable terms.
 
• The **World Bank** is often colloquially referred to as the IBRD, although it is part of the broader World Bank Group that also includes IDA, IFC, MIGA, and ICSID.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **World Bank Group**:

 
 
• The World Bank Group consists of five institutions: IBRD, IDA, IFC, MIGA, and ICSID. These institutions work together to provide financial assistance and advice to developing countries.
 
 
 
• **International Monetary Fund (IMF)**:
 
 
• The IMF is an organization separate from the World Bank, focusing on global monetary cooperation and financial stability.
 
 
 
• **State Bank of India (SBI)**:
 
 
• SBI is India's largest commercial bank and is not associated with the World Bank or the IMF.
 
 
 
• **Reserve Bank of India (RBI)**:
 
 
• The RBI is the central banking institution of India, responsible for monetary policy and regulation of the banking sector in India.
